title: Hari Om v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shashi Kant Gupta and Ajit Kumar, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed; mandamus to decide the 4.4 application refused.
headnote: Mandamus to compel DVVNL to decide a 17.03.2018 application/objection under clause 4.4 (I & IV) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 refused. After the petition was called in revise and none appeared, the Division Bench perused the record, found no ground for the relief, dismissed the writ, and vacated any interim order.
facts: Hari Om petitioned the Allahabad High Court against Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited seeking a mandamus to decide his application/objection dated 17 March 2018 under Section 4.4 (I & IV) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was first listed in June 2018. On 1 August 2018 it was called in revise; none appeared to press it. The Division Bench then perused the record itself.

holding_units.holding: A writ of mandamus commanding the licensee to decide the consumer's 17.03.2018 application/objection as per clause 4.4 (I & IV) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was refused: on perusal of the petition the Court found no ground entitling the petitioner to that relief, dismissed the writ, and vacated any interim order.
holding_units.flag: Prayer cites 'Section 4.4 (I & IV)' in roman capitals; recorded as pleaded, not recast as 4.4(i)/(iv).
